canonical_claim: Provisionally: there exists a source-specified smooth Meyer mother wavelet on the real line whose source-normalized dyadic dilates and integer translates form a complete orthonormal basis of the selected real or complex L^2(R), with the frequency-window construction and Fourier convention fixed by an exact source.
domain_and_universes: Expected domain is the real line with Lebesgue measure and codomain is R or C; the scalar field, L2 representation, Fourier normalization, and whether the witness is represented first as a Schwartz map remain open.
quantifiers: a source-defined smooth cutoff or transition function
a mother wavelet psi on R
elements of the selected L^2(R) space
hypotheses: the cutoff has the source-selected smoothness, symmetry, plateau, transition, and partition identities
Fourier transform, dilation, translation, measure, scalar, and normalization conventions are fixed
conclusion: The constructed mother wavelet has the exact source-claimed smoothness and frequency-support properties, and its normalized dyadic dilates and integer translates satisfy the exact source-claimed orthonormal-basis conclusion.
excluded_degenerate_cases: No claim about Haar or Daubechies wavelets, arbitrary wavelets, wavelet packets, higher dimensions, frames in place of bases, mere existence of an abstract Hilbert basis, or multiresolution analysis beyond the selected construction is included. Smoothness alone without the source's construction and basis conclusion is insufficient.

tcb_profile: Lean kernel 4.29.0 and pinned mathlib are the intended base; exact imports and transitive declaration closure remain open
computation_profile: No oracle, plot, numerical approximation, experiment, or unchecked certificate is credited; the expected smooth cutoff, Fourier transform, L2, and basis constructions are noncomputable

freshness_and_revocation_policy: Invalidate on source selection, construction variant, Fourier convention, domain or measure model, scalar field, smoothness or support requirement, cutoff identities, dilation/translation normalization, Lean target, toolchain, mathlib pin, assurance profile, or validator change; review due date and independent reviewers remain open.
